title: LLP-Bench: A Large Scale Tabular Benchmark for Learning from Label Proportions
summary: LLP-Bench is a large-scale tabular benchmark for learning from label proportions, spanning feature-bag, fixed-size feature-bag, and random-bag dataset constructions with five splits and nine LLP training methods from DLLP variants to optimal-transport approaches. We are standardizing it as the internal eval for all bag-level learning work.
